label: i78-checkvariants-quicksearch
note: Repository quickSearch with objectType=CHKV lists all 19 ATC check variants on the system as adtcore:objectReference rows (upper-case name, lower-case-name checkvariants URI, packageName, description). A plain GET on /sap/bc/adt/atc/checkvariants answers 400 uriMappingError on this release, so quickSearch is how a client actually lists variants.
capturedBy: Standalone python ADT probe (urllib + cookiejar) driven against the A4H sandbox appliance for issue #78's ATC completeness work. REAL wire recording, not synthetic.
requestHeadersNote: Only caller-supplied headers are listed. Authorization, Cookie, X-CSRF-Token and X-sap-adt-sessiontype were added by the probe's own session-management code and are deliberately not recorded.
requestUrlNote: Path and query only; the appliance host is deliberately not recorded, and neither is the sap-client parameter (001) the probe sent.
